title: Holdstation Wallet lifecycle and World Mini App boundary
notes: Stages the missing Holdstation Wallet entity and separates the original mobile wallet from the current World ecosystem Mini App because their runtime/distribution boundaries differ. First-party Holdstation material establishes a self-custodial mobile wallet by 2022, while the current World ecosystem independently confirms a Holdstation Wallet Mini App. The September 2026 WLD bank-cashout/cashback social post is treated as discovery/feature context only and is not promoted as a WLR lifecycle event because it does not establish a material wallet lifecycle or security transition. Follow-up first-party research also found a mandatory March 2026 wallet security upgrade requiring users to back up recovery material, remove the old app and reinstall the latest version; this is staged as a software-fix event without inferring an undisclosed vulnerability or confirmed fund loss.

entities.summary: Holdstation self-custodial software-wallet ecosystem introduced in 2022 and later expanded into account-abstraction smart-wallet functionality and a World ecosystem Mini App.
entities.key_management_model: product-specific; the 2022 mobile wallet used a user-controlled on-device Secret Recovery Phrase/private key, while the current World Mini App key/control boundary requires separate product-level verification
entities.notes: Entity-level custody remains conservative because the original mobile-wallet self-custody model is well documented but the current World Mini App's exact key/control architecture is not established by the reviewed World listing alone.

products.key_management_model: user-controlled Secret Recovery Phrase/private key generated and encrypted on-device in the documented 2022 wallet model
products.summary: Holdstation's mobile self-custody wallet, originally documented with on-device seed/private-key control and later evolved toward smart-wallet/account-abstraction functionality.
products.notes: Android availability was future-facing in the November 2022 tutorial, so WLR does not assign a separate Android launch date. Current support status is left unknown absent a formal first-party maintenance commitment.

products.key_management_model: unknown; current World ecosystem listing establishes the Mini App product but not the exact custody/key-control boundary
products.summary: Holdstation-built wallet Mini App distributed through the World ecosystem for token management, transfers, trading and earning features.
products.notes: No launch date is assigned because the reviewed current listing establishes existence and current distribution, not the first public release date.

events.title: Holdstation Wallet introduced as a self-custodial mobile wallet
events.description: Holdstation's roadmap and November 2022 first-party wallet tutorial establish a 2022 introduction of Holdstation Wallet as a self-custodial mobile wallet using a Secret Recovery Phrase/private key controlled by the user.
events.notes: Only year precision is used. The November tutorial proves the product existed by 2022-11-02, while Holdstation's roadmap places introduction in Q3/Q4 2022; neither source justifies inventing a specific first-launch day.

events.title: Holdstation requires mandatory wallet security upgrade
events.description: Holdstation instructed all wallet users to back up their recovery material, uninstall the old Holdstation app and install the latest March 2026 wallet version as a mandatory security upgrade.
events.notes: The first-party notice calls this a mandatory security patch/upgrade but does not identify a specific vulnerability root cause or establish a canonical amount of affected funds. WLR therefore records the remediation action without inventing an exploit or loss event.
